description: Why: unused parameters add noise and may indicate the parameter was intended to perform a mode check that was never implemented. What: mode_stream.rs handle_mode_stream takes _current_mode: PeeringMode but the leading underscore suppresses the warning rather than removing the parameter or using it. RFC 4644 §2.2 says MODE STREAM can only be sent once; if _current_mode is not used to enforce this, the no-op suppression is hiding a missing guard.
title: _current_mode unused parameter in handle_mode_stream
